name: Cause & Origin Report

steps.label: Date
steps.question: I have the date as {{today}}. Is that correct?

refine.prompt:
You are a technical writer. Convert the user's description into exactly:
I began by flow testing the nearby {{area}} and found them to be free of any leaks.
Upon close inspection of the damage I found most of the damage {damage_location}.
I then flow tested the {{area}} and found a {leak_description}.
User description: "{{raw}}"
Please fill in {damage_location} and {leak_description}.

steps.label: Cause
steps.question: What's the cause of the damage?

refine.prompt: Summarize this as a brief cause phrase: "{{raw}}".

steps.label: Duration
steps.question: How long has the leak been going on?

refine.prompt: Summarize this as a concise duration phrase: "{{raw}}".

steps.label: Moisture Reading
steps.question: What did the moisture meter read?

steps.label: Moisture Meter Photos
steps.question: Take photos of the moisture meter readings.
